items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Well, anyhow, we played several places, and I know Gene did a lot of recording.

ctx.x: Well, anyhow, we played several places, and I know Gene did a lot of recording. I didn't think about them being released as records at the time. But yes...
Martha was interested in knowing whether the musicians were aware that it was being taken down at the time that it happened.
